placebo_caveat: placebo shuffles only the final win/loss label; the early-exit channel reads the REAL intra-window price path, so residual non-causal structure survives a label-only shuffle. A non-zero placebo here = small-n overfitting + path structure, NOT a validated edge. A cleaner placebo would permute whole episodes.
data_caveat: n=218 windows — far below the deflated-Sharpe / purged-CV threshold for a trustworthy verdict. Provisional pipeline read only; accrue via rl_treatment_dataset.py before trusting any edge.
honesty: RL follows the Oracle's direction and only decides skip/size/exit; it cannot and does not predict direction. Coverage vs T0 is measured, never fitted toward a target.
